items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And that Teddy Weatherford that you heard, I can speak about, he was, he was among the tops too.

ctx.x: Yes. Mm-hmm. He didn't have quite the, the improvising technique of Cass. Cass was tremendous. He was really tremendous. And that Teddy Weatherford that you heard, I can speak about, he was, he was among the tops too. It was, but I mean, in those days, it's not like you look back over it, you know. You look back and you remember how it was. In those days, we knew it was good, and we didn't, we just said, well, he's going to like to work with him.
Well, Teddy recorded some piano solos in India.
